prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine find relevant passages of EU law for a business process.

Below is a description of a business process. Rewrite it as short search queries in the vocabulary of EU law
(for example: consumer, trader, distance contract, right of withdrawal, pre-contractual information, commercial
transaction, late payment, interest for late payment, personal data, data subject, controller, conformity of goods,
information society service, order confirmation).

Rules:
- Write between 3 and 8 queries.
- Each query is at most 12 words.
- Use only concepts that the process description supports. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Write one query per line. No numbering, no explanations, no other text.

Process description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

customer login confirmation  
product selection and cart management  
order placement and payment initiation  
payment data entry and confirmation  
shipping address input and billing address  
payment confirmation and order completion  
distance contract and pre-contractual information  
information society service and order confirmation
queries: shipping address input and billing address
information society service and order confirmation
